## GET `/103/mainframe/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/split`

**Tier:** T0  

This call retrieves the Splits available on a specific system.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The System ID |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `splitList` · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error

## POST `/103/mainframe/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/split`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

This call creates a new Split on the specified System.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The System ID |

**Request body** (required): `createSplitParam`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `executionOption` | string (enum: `SYNCHRONOUS`, `ASYNCHRONOUS`) |  |
| `split_Name` | string | The name of the split. |
| `pav_Type` | string | The PAV type. Valid PAV types are Hyper, Super and Dynamic. |
| `ports_To_Associates` | array of string | The List of director ports to be associated with the split. Example EF:1D. |

**Responses:** `201` Created → `split` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error

| `new_Pav_Type_Param` | `modifySplitPavType` | Change the split PAV type |
